cq: What is the latitude and longitude of the city where the transaction with ID '2da90c7d74bd46a0caf3777415b3ebd3' occurred?
sparql:
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX geo1: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
PREFIX lkg: <http://example.org/lkg#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

ASK {
  ?transaction a ex:CreditCardTransaction ;
               ex:atMerchant ?merchant .
  ?merchant schema:address ?address .
  ?address geo1:lat ?latitude ;
           geo1:long ?longitude .
}

sparql:
